newsitem.title: USA: Microelectronic to be delisted from NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Microelectronic to be delisted from NASDAQ.

text.p: Microelectronic Packaging Inc said it received notice March 4 from Nasdaq that it is in violation of the Nasdaq listing criteria requiring a minimum of $4 million in net tangible assets.
As a result, the company said it is scheduled to be delisted from the Nasdaq National Market System effective at the close of business on Tuesday, March 11, 1997.
Beginning March 12, 1997, the company's securities will be traded on the Nasdaq Bulletin Board.
Management is currently restructuring the company's operations as was previously announced on March 3, 1997.
